name: FracStageCompletionTracker
tagline: Every frac stage, every well, every fleet – plan vs actual pumping in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete hydraulic fracturing completions app for Power Apps and Power Pages: track plug & perf and pumping stage by stage, enforce toe-to-heel sequence and one-stage-per-fleet rules, record screen-outs and NPT, compare design and actual proppant, fluid and pump hours, and see crew efficiency per fleet-day. Works with demo data the moment it is dropped on a screen.
features: Stage map (wells × stages) coloured by status, placement or pressure
Plug & perf, Pumping, Pumped, Screened out, On hold and Skipped workflow with rules
Toe-to-heel sequence and one stage per fleet enforcement
Placement vs design with under-placed flags
Stages per fleet-day vs target, pump-time efficiency, NPT by reason
Forecast finish at the current rate
Add a whole well of stages in one step
Bulk hold / skip, undo, CSV export
Power Fx outputs and OnSave / OnCreate / OnAction / OnStatusChange events
Phone layout with bottom view bar
